latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of feishu-sheets-reader.

- Enables creation, reading, writing, and appending data to Feishu Sheets.
- Supports inserting and deleting rows/columns and managing worksheets.
- Provides sheet and cell range selection, including use of sheet IDs.
- Returns metadata and sheet structure information.
- Offers examples for all supported spreadsheet actions.
